text:
mike: Quick Q — we need to standardize how the console surfaces change provenance for routing/quotas/rollouts. Legal asked for exportable, tamper-evident records. Thoughts? @lara
lara: +1. Schema proposal: actor, action, resource_id, before, after, rollout_id, policy_id, environment, correlation_id, timestamp, source(api/ui), user_agent. Keep it minimal.
jamie: Agree. Also include change_reason and effective_at for scheduled rollouts. We should version the schema (v1).
anya: For telemetry, include numeric diffs for quotas/thresholds and a lightweight fingerprint to de-dup frontend events.
oliver: From legal: need approver (if applicable), IP, and an immutable export path. Prefer NDJSON line format for exports and a signed manifest.
deploy-bot: rollout/42 -> completed :white_check_mark:
jamie: Prototype NDJSON shape (example):
```json
{"schema_version":"1","timestamp":"2025-06-14T15:12:34Z","actor":"lara","actor_id":"U123","action":"update","resource_type":"routing_policy","resource_id":"rp-77","before":{"routes":[{"weight":80}]},"after":{"routes":[{"weight":60}]},"rollout_id":"ro-42","correlation_id":"c-9a8b","source":"console","ip":"192.0.2.1","approval":{"approver":"oliver","approved_at":"2025-06-14T15:11:00Z"}}
```
sam: Storage options: write to internal audit-events table + async export to S3 (object lock) with signed manifest. Retention/erase policies must be policy-driven.
lara: UX: console should show compact diff + "export as NDJSON" button on an audit row. Also let SRE request replay by correlation_id.
mike: OK. Can someone spin up a quick proto and a PR describing storage+export contract? @jamie to take first pass? :thumbsup:
jamie: I'll drop a gist + RFC tomorrow and open a PR next week. pulling in @sam for S3/options.
oliver: Thanks—will review compliance checklist once you have the proto.
anya: tagging analytics folks to think about sampling strategy for telemetry (avoid full export for heavy churn): @anya
mike: sweet, thanks everyone. We'll sync during next eng-platform sync.
